getAuditReports(address,uint256,uint256).details: Returns reports starting from the most recent (end of array)If the token has no audit reports, falls back to its factory's audit reports

params.limit: The maximum number of reports to return
params.offset: The number of reports to skip from the end (0 = most recent)
params.taxToken: The address of the tax token

returns.total: The total number of audit reports for this token

returns.description: Human-readable explanation of the current policy
returns.policyData: Raw 32-byte slot holding policy-specific data.         For TIME_DEPENDENT: top 64 bits = expirationTime (unix timestamp),         next 160 bits = developer address, remaining 32 bits = zero.

getVault(address).details: Reverts if no vault is found for the given tax tokenAttempts to fetch the vault's description by calling its description() function

params.taxToken: The address of the tax token

returns.info: The VaultInfo struct containing complete vault details

newTaxTokenWithVault((string,string,stri.details: This function orchestrates the creation of both the vault and the tax tokenThe vault is created first using the predicted token address, then the token is createdRequires msg.value to match or exceed the quoteAmt for initial liquidityAny vault factory can be used. If the factory is not registered or is disabled,      the vault will be treated as unofficial with UNVERIFIED risk level

params.params: The parameters for creating the tax token and vault

returns.token: The address of the newly created tax token

newTokenV6WithVault((string,string,strin.details: Only TOKEN_TAXED_V3 is currently supported as tokenVersion; any other version reverts with FeatureDisabled.

params.params: The parameters for creating the tax token and vault (mirrors NewTokenV6Params, minus beneficiary)

returns.token: The address of the newly created tax token

predictTaxTokenV1Address(bytes32).details: Uses CREATE2 deterministic address predictionUseful for generating valid salts that produce the required vanity suffix

returns.predictedAddress: The predicted address of the tax token

refreshTokenVault(address).details: Only callable by AUDITOR_ROLE.      If the token has no entry in taxVaults, the call is silently ignored.      If the on-chain market wallet differs from the stored vault, the stored vault is updated      and a TokenVaultRefreshed event is emitted.

params.token: The tax token address to refresh.

params.adapter: The address of the adapter contract
params.taxToken: The address of the tax token

params.enabled: Whether the factory should be enabled for creating new vaults
params.factory: The address of the vault factory to register/update
params.official: Whether vaults from this factory should be marked as official
params.riskLevel: The risk level classification for vaults from this factory

registerVaultFactory(address,bool,bool,u.details: Only accounts with VAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can call this functionAllows enabling/disabling factories and updating their official/riskLevel/category status

params.factory: The address of the vault factory to register/update
params.official: Whether vaults from this factory should be marked as official
params.riskLevel: The risk level classification for vaults from this factory

resetFactoryPolicy(address).details: Only callable by AUDITOR_ROLE.  Clears any stored policy data (expiration / developer).

submitAuditReport(address,uint8,string).details: Only accounts with AUDITOR_ROLE can call this functionThe tax token must exist (have a vault or adapter registered)This may change the risk level of the token

params.ipfsCid: The IPFS CID of the audit report document
params.riskLevel: The risk level classification from this audit
params.taxToken: The address of the tax token being audited

submitFactoryAuditReport(address,uint8,s.details: Only accounts with VAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can call this functionThe factory should be registered or have existing audit reports

params.riskLevel: The risk level classification from this audit

tryGetVault(address).details: First checks the internal mapping, then falls back to searching the PortalFor fallback results, isOfficial and isVerified will always be false

params.taxToken: The address of the tax token

returns.found: Whether a vault was found for this tax token
returns.info: The VaultInfo struct (empty if not found)

params.factory: The address of the vault factory

returns.enabled: Whether this factory can be used to create new vaults
returns.official: Whether vaults created by this factory are marked as official/endorsed
returns.reserved: Reserved space for future upgrades (29 bytes)
returns.riskLevel: The risk level classification for vaults from this factory
